name: Inline edit
description: A value that becomes an input where it sits: a page or card title, a project name, a version, a due date. Click it or press Enter to edit, Enter saves, Esc cancels, blur saves, and a multiline field grows as you type and saves on Mod+Enter.

classes.ayy-inline-edit: Root: a grid cell shared by the display button and the field, so swapping them never moves the content around it. Put the raw value in data-value.
classes.ayy-inline-edit__display: The value at rest, as a <button type="button"> named by aria-label ("Rename the project"). It is hidden while the field is open.
classes.ayy-inline-edit__text: The value inside the display button. It may be formatted (24 Oct 2026 while data-value is 2026-10-24); when empty, data-placeholder shows as muted text.
classes.ayy-inline-edit__input: The field: .ayy-input for one line or .ayy-textarea with rows="1" for more. Hidden until editing starts.
classes.ayy-inline-edit--title: Title variant: the display and the field take --ayy-font-heading at --ayy-text-xl, semibold.

default.looks: The value as plain text on a transparent button; a small wash appears on hover. The field is hidden in the same grid cell.

hover.looks: A --ayy-color-wash behind the value, so it reads as editable. The field keeps Input's or Textarea's own hover border.

pressed.none: No pressed look: the click opens the field, which is the feedback.

focus.looks: The display gets the 2px --ayy-color-ring outline at 2px offset; the field uses Input's or Textarea's own ring.

disabled.when: disabled on the display button and the field
disabled.looks: --ayy-opacity-disabled and a not-allowed cursor. Forced colours: GrayText.

error.when: aria-invalid="true" on the field (passed through inputProps or textareaProps)
error.looks: Input's or Textarea's destructive border and focus ring. Say why in a FieldError.

loading.none: No loading look. Disable the field while a save is in flight and show a Spinner or a Toast when it fails.

editing.when: editing / defaultEditing, or a click or Enter on the display button
editing.looks: The display is hidden and the field takes the same grid cell, focused with all its text selected (caret at the end on a textarea). A textarea grows with its content.

sizes.density: The field follows Input or Textarea: --ayy-size-control-md (32px compact, 40px comfortable, 44px touch) and --ayy-control-text-field. The title variant's --ayy-text-xl type stays the same at every density.
sizes.width: Fills its container. The display text wraps long words, keeps the author's line breaks and never scrolls sideways; a multiline field grows to its content.

js: inlineEditClass({ variant?, className? }) → root classes; inlineEditVariants; isComposingEvent(event) → true during IME composition; commitsOnEnter(event, multiline?) → whether that Enter saves; growInlineEdit(textarea) → size a textarea to its content; connectInlineEdit(root, { onCommit?, onCancel?, onEditingChange?, trim? }) → { start, commit, cancel, isEditing, destroy } wires plain markup.

element.description: Wraps an .ayy-inline-edit and makes it work: the display button opens the field, Enter saves (Mod+Enter in a textarea), Esc cancels and blur saves. The markup decides whether the field is an <input> or a <textarea>. A commit writes the value back to data-value and .ayy-inline-edit__text; an app showing formatted text listens for ayy-change and rewrites the text itself. startEditing(), commit() and cancel() drive it from code.

events.ayy-change: { value } — after a commit, only when the value changed. Update any formatted display text from it.
events.ayy-edit: { editing } — true when the field opens, false however it closes.

InlineEdit.renders: <div class="ayy-inline-edit" data-value> <button class="ayy-inline-edit__display"><span class="ayy-inline-edit__text"> + <input class="ayy-input ayy-inline-edit__input"> (or <textarea class="ayy-textarea ..." rows="1">)

props.value / defaultValue: string — the raw value; value makes it controlled
props.onValueChange: (value: string) => void — after a commit, only when the value changed
props.label: string — the display button's and the field's aria-label, written as the action ("Rename the project")
props.displayValue: ReactNode — what the display shows at rest; defaults to the value (a formatted date, a price)
props.placeholder: string — shown when the value is empty, in the display and in the field
props.multiline: boolean — use a growing <textarea>; saves on ⌘Enter / Ctrl+Enter
props.disabled: boolean — disables the display button and the field
props.editing / defaultEditing: boolean — edit mode, controlled, or the starting one
props.onEditingChange: (editing: boolean) => void — when edit mode starts or ends
props.onCancel: () => void — Esc threw the draft away
props.trim: boolean — trim the value on commit. Default true
props.inputProps: props for the single-line <input> (id, aria-describedby, aria-invalid, autoComplete…)
props.className: string — on the root, never on the field

a11y: The display is a real button and the field is a real input: give both the same aria-label (label in React), written as the action ("Rename the project"), and keep it when the value changes.
Enter saves, Esc cancels and puts focus back on the display button; blur and Tab save without pulling focus back.
Enter while an IME is composing is left to the IME, so a Japanese, Chinese or Korean word can be confirmed without saving.
The empty value shows the placeholder as text, not as the only name: the button keeps its aria-label.
do: Use inline edit for a short value people rename in place: a page title, a project or file name, a version, a due date.
Write the label as the action ("Rename the project"), and keep a formatted displayValue in React when the raw value isn't what people should read.
Keep the raw value in data-value (plain HTML) and format only the .ayy-inline-edit__text.
dont: Don't use it for long-form content or a value filled once in a form — use Field + Label with a Textarea or Input.
Don't put formatted text in data-value: the field edits the raw value, and the app rewrites the display from ayy-change.
Don't use it for a value that needs more than one field — open a Dialog or use Settings rows.
